scenes.headline: How a game engine and video model share frames
scenes.sub: Code runs the race. A video model paints it, chunk by chunk.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chicane! This racing game is painted by a video model while you drive. Here's how the work is split.

scenes.text: The engine sends only a flat-colour semantic map each frame; a two-step H3 renderer paints every pixel from a reference image and a prompt.
scenes.say: The engine sends only a flat colour map. A two step video model paints every pixel from a reference image and a prompt.

steps.say: Left, the engine's own render. Plain, but exact.
Middle, the semantic map: one flat colour per class.
Right, what the model paints from it.
You steer. The engine applies it to its physics and keeps the map and the cars in code.
Every frame it paints the scene in flat colours. No lighting, no texture.
The map enters the video model as a reference video. The look comes from a picture and a prompt set at the start.
A causal decoder makes frames, and you react. Your keys never reach the model, only their effect on the map.

left.title: A world model
items: The network imagines what happens next
left.say: A world model imagines what happens next, with your actions fed straight in.

right.title: StreamRender-H3
items: The model decides how it looks
right.say: Here code decides what happens. The model only decides how it looks.

scenes.title: Teaching it to stream
scenes.say: Training runs in stages on one sliding window.

items.say: Teacher forcing, on targets native H3 generated.
Resampling forcing, so its history holds its own mistakes.
Guidance trained into the weights, one call instead of three.
Then distillation, from sixteen steps to two.

scenes.title: Keeping up is not answering fast
scenes.note: From the runtime's schedule; transport not included
scenes.say: It renders a chunk faster than the chunk plays, so it keeps up. But a frame reaches the screen about one and a half seconds after the engine drew it.

scenes.text: Let code own what must be exact, and give the model only class labels to paint.
scenes.say: Let code own what must be exact, and give the model only class labels to paint.

recap: The engine sends flat colours only
H3 paints them in two steps
Throughput is real time; lag is not
scenes.say: Flat colours in, two steps of paint, and a lag worth measuring.
